1: ## Tasks

3: ### Setup
4: 
5: - [x] Task 0: (all tasks complete — see commit history on sse-stability branch) Create feature branch in code repo
6:   **Repo:** `finding-a-bed-tonight/`

9: ### Server — SseEmitter Hardening
10: 
11: - [x] Task 1: Change SseEmitter timeout to -1L
12:   **File:** `backend/src/main/java/org/fabt/notification/service/NotificationService.java`
13:   **Action:** Change `EMITTER_TIMEOUT_MS` from `5 * 60 * 1000L` to `-1L`. Update the comment to explain: no server-side timeout; dead connections detected by heartbeat failure. Verify `onTimeout` callback still registered (it becomes a no-op with -1L but doesn't hurt).
14: 
15: - [x] Task 2: Tighten heartbeat to 20 seconds
16:   **File:** `backend/src/main/java/org/fabt/notification/service/NotificationService.java`
17:   **Action:** Change `@Scheduled(fixedRate = 30_000)` to `@Scheduled(fixedRate = 20_000)`. Update constant/comment. This gives nginx 6 heartbeat cycles before `proxy_read_timeout 120s` expires. Wrap each individual heartbeat send in a try-catch — if any send throws or takes longer than 5 seconds, treat as dead connection and remove the emitter immediately. Do not let one slow/stuck emitter block heartbeats to other clients.
18: 
19: - [x] Task 3: Send initial connection event with retry field
20:   **File:** `backend/src/main/java/org/fabt/notification/service/NotificationService.java`
21:   **Action:** In the `register()` method, after creating the emitter, immediately send:
22:   ```java
23:   emitter.send(SseEmitter.event()
24:       .id(String.valueOf(eventIdCounter.incrementAndGet()))
25:       .name("connected")
26:       .data("{\"heartbeatInterval\":20000}")
27:       .reconnectTime(5000));
28:   ```
29:   Include monotonic `id:` on this and ALL subsequent events. **Heartbeats should also be named events** (`event: heartbeat`) with incrementing `id:` — not SSE comments. This ensures `Last-Event-ID` stays current even during quiet periods (if heartbeats are comments, they don't advance the ID, and reconnect replay would include everything since the last real event). The client's `onmessage` handler ignores `heartbeat` events (no UI action).
30: 
31: - [x] Task 4: Add Last-Event-ID replay buffer
32:   **File:** `backend/src/main/java/org/fabt/notification/service/NotificationService.java`
33:   **Action:** Add a `ConcurrentLinkedDeque<BufferedEvent>` with max 100 entries and 5-minute age limit. On every `broadcast()`, add the event to the buffer (evict old). In `register()`, check for `Last-Event-ID` (passed from controller). If present and found in buffer, replay events after that ID **filtered by the reconnecting user's tenant and role permissions** (same filtering logic already in `onDomainEvent`). If not found, send a `refresh` event type. Add `BufferedEvent` record: `(long id, String eventType, String data, UUID tenantId, boolean requiresDvAccess, Instant timestamp)`. The tenant and DV fields enable per-user filtering during replay without leaking cross-tenant events.
34: 
35: - [x] Task 5: Accept Last-Event-ID in controller
36:   **File:** `backend/src/main/java/org/fabt/notification/api/NotificationController.java`
37:   **Action:** Add `@RequestHeader(value = "Last-Event-ID", required = false) String lastEventId` parameter. Pass to `notificationService.register(...)`. Parse to `long` if present.
38: 
39: - [x] Task 6: Add graceful shutdown for emitters
40:   **File:** `backend/src/main/java/org/fabt/notification/service/NotificationService.java`
41:   **Action:** Add `@PreDestroy` method that iterates all emitters and calls `complete()`. Log the count of closed connections.
42: 
43: - [x] Task 7: Add deprecation warning to SseTokenFilter
44:   **File:** `backend/src/main/java/org/fabt/shared/security/SseTokenFilter.java`
45:   **Action:** When the filter extracts a token from the `?token=` query param, log at WARN level: `"SSE auth via query param is deprecated — use Authorization header instead (user: {})"`. Keep filter functional for backward compatibility.
46: 
47: ### Server — Observability
48: 
49: - [ ] Task 8: Add Micrometer SSE metrics
50:   **File:** `backend/src/main/java/org/fabt/notification/service/NotificationService.java`
51:   **Action:** Inject `MeterRegistry`. Register 4 metrics:
52:   - `Gauge.builder("sse.connections.active", activeConnections, AtomicInteger::get)`
53:   - `Counter.builder("sse.reconnections.total")` — increment when `lastEventId` is present on register
54:   - `Timer.builder("sse.event.delivery.duration")` — wrap the `emitters.forEach(send)` loop
55:   - `Counter.builder("sse.send.failures.total")` — increment on IOException in send/heartbeat
56: 
57: - [ ] Task 9: Add Grafana SSE health panel
58:   **File:** `grafana/dashboards/fabt-operations.json`
59:   **Action:** Add an "SSE Health" row with 3 panels: active connections gauge, reconnection rate, send failure rate. Use Prometheus queries matching the metric names from Task 8.
60: 
61: ### Client — fetch-event-source Migration
62: 
63: - [ ] Task 10: Install @microsoft/fetch-event-source
64:   **Action:** `cd frontend && npm install @microsoft/fetch-event-source`
65: 
66: - [ ] Task 11: Rewrite useNotifications hook
67:   **File:** `frontend/src/hooks/useNotifications.ts`
68:   **Action:** Replace native `EventSource` with `fetchEventSource`:
69:   - Use `Authorization: Bearer ${token}` header (not query-param)
70:   - Set `openWhenHidden: false` (Page Visibility auto-handling)
71:   - In `onmessage`: route `ev.event` through a dispatch map matching the current `addEventListener` names: `{ 'dv-referral.responded': handleReferralResponse, 'dv-referral.requested': handleReferralRequest, 'availability.updated': handleAvailabilityUpdate, 'connected': handleConnected, 'refresh': handleRefresh }`. Reset retry counter on any message.
72:   - In `onerror`: return exponential backoff delay (initial 1s, max 30s, factor 2, 30% jitter)
73:   - In `onopen`: verify response is OK, set `connected = true`
74:   - Remove `catchUp()` function entirely
75:   - Remove `SSE_REFERRAL_UPDATE` and `SSE_AVAILABILITY_UPDATE` window event dispatching on reconnect
76:   - On `refresh` event: dispatch both events ONCE (single bulk refetch for large gap)
77:   - Remove `reconnectingRef` and `lastCatchUpRef` (no longer needed)
78: 
79: - [ ] Task 12: Preserve real-time update listeners, remove reconnect-triggered refetch
80:   **File:** `frontend/src/pages/OutreachSearch.tsx`
81:   **Action:** The `SSE_REFERRAL_UPDATE` and `SSE_AVAILABILITY_UPDATE` window event listeners in OutreachSearch MUST REMAIN — they are how real-time updates reach the search results when a coordinator updates availability or a referral is responded to. What changes is WHO dispatches them:
82:   - **Before:** `catchUp()` dispatched both events on every SSE reconnect → refetch storm
83:   - **After:** The `onmessage` handler in `useNotifications` dispatches `SSE_AVAILABILITY_UPDATE` only when an actual `availability.updated` SSE event arrives, and `SSE_REFERRAL_UPDATE` only when a `dv-referral.*` event arrives. The `refresh` event type dispatches both (single bulk catchup for large gaps).
84:   - **Verify:** After implementation, real-time updates still work (coordinator updates beds → outreach worker sees change within seconds).

86: ### Backend Tests

88: - [ ] Task 13: Add SSE stability integration tests
89:   **File:** `backend/src/test/java/org/fabt/notification/SseStabilityTest.java` (new)
90:   **Action:** Using Java HttpClient with `BodyHandlers.ofLines()`:
91:   - `test_sseConnection_staysAlive_60seconds` — connect, wait 60s, verify no timeout/disconnect
92:   - `test_heartbeat_receivedEvery20Seconds` — count heartbeat comments in 45s window, expect ≥ 2
93:   - `test_initialEvent_containsRetryAndId` — verify first event has `retry:`, `id:`, `event: connected`
94:   - `test_lastEventId_replaysFromBuffer` — send events, disconnect, reconnect with Last-Event-ID, verify missed events replayed
95:   - `test_lastEventId_stale_sendsRefresh` — reconnect with unknown ID, verify `refresh` event
96:   - `test_deadConnection_cleanedUp` — close client, wait 25s, verify emitter removed from registry
97:   - `test_metrics_registered` — verify all 4 Micrometer metrics exist and update

100:   **File:** `backend/src/test/java/org/fabt/notification/SseNotificationIntegrationTest.java`
101:   **Action:** Run existing SSE tests first to establish baseline after Tasks 1-9 changes. Verify they still pass with the new timeout (-1L) and heartbeat (20s) changes. Update any assertions that depended on the 5-minute timeout behavior. This must pass before writing new stability tests (Task 13).

103: ### Playwright E2E Tests
104: 
105: - [ ] Task 15: Add EventSource/fetch wrapper for test instrumentation
106:   **File:** `e2e/playwright/fixtures/sse-instrumentation.ts` (new)
107:   **Action:** Create a reusable `addInitScript` that wraps `fetch` calls to the SSE endpoint, capturing:
108:   - Connection count (how many times SSE endpoint was opened)
109:   - Events received (array of `{type, data, id}`)
110:   - Expose via `window.__sseConnections` and `window.__sseEvents`

113:   **File:** `e2e/playwright/tests/sse-connectivity.spec.ts` (new, replaces assertions in offline-behavior.spec.ts)
114:   **Action:** Using the instrumentation from Task 15:
115:   - `test_sseStaysConnected_30seconds` — assert `window.__sseConnections === 1` after 30 seconds (use `test.slow()`)
116:   - `test_sseReceivesHeartbeats` — assert heartbeat events received in `window.__sseEvents`
117:   - `test_noRefetchStorm` — count requests to `/api/v1/queries/beds` over 30s, assert ≤ 1 (initial load only)
118:   - `test_pageVisibility_closesAndReconnects` — background tab, verify connection closed, foreground, verify reconnect without UI disruption
119:   - Run in both default (Vite) and nginx Playwright profiles
120: 
121: - [ ] Task 17: Remove misleading offline test assertion
122:   **File:** `e2e/playwright/tests/offline-behavior.spec.ts`
123:   **Action:** Remove or rewrite test 3 ("queued availability update replays on reconnect") which only asserts page doesn't crash. This test's real assertions are now in `sse-connectivity.spec.ts` (Task 16) and will be in the `offline-honesty` change for actual queue/replay behavior.
124: 
125: ### Gatling Performance
126: 
127: - [ ] Task 18: Create SseStabilitySimulation
128:   **File:** `e2e/gatling/src/gatling/java/fabt/SseStabilitySimulation.java` (new)
129:   **Action:** Gatling SSE simulation:
130:   - Login, obtain JWT
131:   - Open SSE connection to `/api/v1/notifications/stream` with `Authorization` header
132:   - Hold connection for 60 seconds
133:   - Verify heartbeat events received at ~20s intervals
134:   - Close connection
135:   - Inject: ramp 200 users over 60 seconds
136:   - Assertions: 0 unexpected disconnects, heartbeats received, p99 heartbeat latency < 100ms
137:   - **Must run through nginx** (use `baseUrl: http://localhost:8081` when `nginx-dev-parity` is available)
138:   - Verify Gatling SSE API supports custom headers (`sse("Connect").get(url).header("Authorization", "Bearer #{jwt}")`). If not supported, keep query-param token auth as Gatling-only fallback and document why.

140: ### Documentation

142: - [ ] Task 19: Update documentation
143:   **Files:** `oracle-demo-runbook-v0.21.0.md` (local only), `docs/FOR-DEVELOPERS.md` (committed)
144:   **Action:**
145:   - **Runbook:** Update "Bed Search page keeps refreshing" troubleshooting entry to reflect the root cause fix (SseEmitter timeout, not just nginx buffering). Add: "If `sse.connections.active` shows a sawtooth pattern in Grafana, the SseEmitter timeout may have regressed."
146:   - **FOR-DEVELOPERS.md:** Add "SSE Architecture" section explaining: SseEmitter with -1L timeout, 20s named-event heartbeats, Last-Event-ID replay buffer, `@microsoft/fetch-event-source` with backoff+jitter, Page Visibility integration, 4 Micrometer metrics. This ensures the architecture persists with the code, not just in the runbook.

153:   2. Playwright (Vite): `npx playwright test 2>&1 | tee /tmp/pw-vite-sse.log`
154:   3. Playwright (nginx): `npx playwright test --project=nginx 2>&1 | tee /tmp/pw-nginx-sse.log` (requires nginx-dev-parity)
